A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]<ref name="Sabotage" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. She was one of the [[Four Masters/Legends|Four Masters]] who built a new [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Ossus (Great Sith War)|devastation]] of [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and the [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Great Jedi Library]] located there during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Along with the three other founding [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], the Twi'lek was immortalized through a bas-relief sculpted in a massive pylon displayed at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|main entrance]] to the Temple.<ref name="SW:CL" />
